title: Retain Bank
description: A curated set of golden (prompt, expected_output) pairs that the model must NOT regress on during fine-tuning. Retained via DPO negative anchors or supervised replay. One bank = one model × one purpose. Run validator_eval_id after every fine-tune pass; fail = rollback.

model_target.description: HF model ID or internal alias this bank is guarding. Example: 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct' or 'kael-7b-v2'.

purpose.description: 'hard_failures' = behaviors the model has failed before that must not resurface; 'behavior_anchor' = personality/style invariants; 'format_canonical' = exact output format the ecosystem depends on; 'domain_facts' = factual claims the model must hold.

rows.description: The golden examples. Each row is a (prompt, expected_output) pair with optional provenance.

prompt.description: Full system + user prompt to replay.

expected_output.description: The output the model must reproduce (or match semantically, per validator_eval_id definition).

evidence.description: Optional: citation for why this row was added. Example: 'GLOBAL-E-08: agent fabricated attribution 2026-04-21'.

source_dataset_id.description: Optional: dataset_block.dataset_id this row was extracted from.

row_count.description: Must equal rows.length. Maintained by the curation pipeline.

last_validated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful validator_eval_id pass.

validator_eval_id.description: Eval ID that runs this bank as a regression suite post-fine-tune. Failure = rollback signal.

license_class.description: 'customer_private' rows do not belong in a retain bank — keep them in customer_soul adapters.

rows.prompt: You are a GAD agent. Stamp task GLOBAL-T-80-04 as done with runtime codex-cli.
rows.expected_output: gad tasks stamp GLOBAL-T-80-04 --projectid global --status done --agent qwen-agent --runtime codex-cli
rows.evidence: GLOBAL-E-08: agent fabricated codex attribution without running gad runtime launch
